useCase: Verifying real human presence 비디오에서 through remote photoplethysmography 분석
mechanism: 추출합니다 subtle color changes in facial skin caused by blood circulation (rPPG signal) and 분석 its temporal characteristics. Real faces exhibit periodic color fluctuations corresponding to heartbeat. AI 생성 faces lack these physiological signals or produce incoherent 패턴.

parameters: ROI: forehead + cheeks, Sampling: 30fps minimum, Window: 10 seconds, Frequency range: 0.7-4.0 Hz
